item.tib: rdzogs chen gser thur sprul pa'i don mdzad 'phrin las mkha' 'gro'i las tshogs
item.coloph: e ma skal ldan las 'phro yod pa'i rdo gling ngas/ bon ban gnyis kyi thugs gtad rgya mtsho rnyed/ re dogs bdag 'dzin skad gcig nyid las grol/ gu yangs blo bde shes pa khral ma khrol/ dad ldan yod na gdams pa sbyin no shog mdo sngags bka' gter tha mal sdom gyis yod/ gang byas don ldan bu 'phrad bon gyi phug nor bu yod dus gsol ba gdab na 'thad/ skal ldan gyi bu'i don du/ bI ros (ro) rtsa nas phyag la phab bo/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya gter rgya sbas rgya zab rgya
